item.title: Week 10: Chargers at Ravens
item.description: Mon 11/16 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: BAL -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model BAL 88% vs. market 66% | On paper Baltimore has the edge (Baltimore's defense ranks 15th in EPA per dropback, +0.02 allowed). Under center, Justin Herbert ranks 31st of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Zay Flowers gets 28% of Baltimore's targets and 28% of its air yards, and His WOPR (0.68) ranks 9th of 1211. The Chargers' pass defense ranks 8th. The model favors Baltimore at 88%, mostly on rushing matchup (5.4 pts) and starting QB (3.4 pts).
